snippet.title: Montabi - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder where you must build your deck by taming and assembling a team of Montabi. Engage in thrilling turn-based battles, strategically utilizing their unique abilities. Become the ultimate Montabi tamer and save the city from the evil organization.

Develop by Mankibo, Published by Akupara Games

► Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141630/Montabi/
